blocks.heading: Automate Your Most Challenging Insertion Tasks

nodes.text: Automate Your Most Challenging Insertion Tasks

The **S7900 Odd Form Series Insertion Machine** is engineered to master the complexities of modern PCB assembly. It simulates and replaces laborious manual operations, delivering unparalleled precision and efficiency when handling non-standard, "odd-form" electronic components.

Designed with advanced multi-axis motion, a sophisticated vision system, and intuitive software, the S7900 ensures flawless placement, boosts throughput, and significantly enhances your production line's capabilities.
Key Features of the S7900
Multi-axis Precision
Enables intricate and flexible handling of various odd-form components with superior accuracy.
Intelligent Vision System
Accurately identifies and locates components and MARK points for precise, error-free placement.
Intuitive Software Interface
Simplifies program creation, parameter adjustments, and real-time monitoring for ease of use.
Adaptive Tooling
Customizable grippers and nozzles adapt to a wide range of component shapes and sizes.
Integrated Safety Measures
Safety covers, gratings, and emergency stops ensure a secure operating environment.
Simplified Maintenance
Designed for straightforward routine lubrication and cleaning, minimizing downtime.
Experience the S7900 Advantage
Increased Efficiency & Throughput
Automate odd-form component insertion, drastically reducing manual labor and accelerating production cycles.
Superior Accuracy & Quality
Minimize placement errors and defects, ensuring consistently high-quality PCB assemblies.
Enhanced Flexibility & Adaptability
Handles a diverse array of components and PCB layouts, adapting to varied production needs.
Reduced Operational Costs
Optimizes labor utilization, minimizes waste, and lowers overall production expenses.
Robust Safety & Reliability
Comprehensive safety features ensure operator well-being and minimal equipment downtime.
Seamless Integration
MES communication capabilities allow for seamless data exchange and process control within your factory.

blocks.heading: Simplified Operation: From Startup to Production

nodes.text: Simplified Operation: From Startup to Production

items.text: Easy Startup: Connect power and air, turn on the main switch and computer, launch the software, and perform a quick machine zeroing.
Program Creation: Effortlessly create new programs by defining part data, PCB parameters, MARK points, and teaching block/hole data.
Automated Learning: Utilize the automatic learning feature to quickly define insertion data, ensuring efficient setup for new components.
Flexible Array Editing: Choose between general editing for single PCBs or advanced array editing for panel form PCBs.
Quick Nozzle Replacement: Tool-free nozzle/gripper replacement ensures minimal downtime and maximum versatility.
